primary_cohort: new24 F4 blocks5/6, each two assigned read policies; policy is not a separate independent block
secondary_cohort: carry21 source cases retain prior order; no cross-version acceptance splicing
inclusion: all assignments, no achieved phase, survival-to-B or good-result selection; censored/unknown remain
state_fields: current loss and current remaining height margin
historical max loss and irreversible ever-failed label
LP and finite-difference truth vertical velocity
filter/joint/consumed and latest observed bridge command
LP/att/execution age and direct pre-read/GRU stage
B_before_comparison: AB vs B-alone at the same absolute planned B start minus one controller sample; preserve pre-A imbalance, no pure causal attribution
hold_clipping: actual unclipped target-yaw inputs across the entire real capture-to-resume interval, not only capture instant
cost_windows: full task0 to nominal end and each AB/REPAIR common observed absolute event-to-end window separately; never compare incomplete integral to full integral

execution_cost_secondary.squared_actual_scaled_joint_integral: sum integral w_i^2 dt; rad^2/s proxy, not electrical energy
execution_cost_secondary.consumed_command_total_variation: sum abs delta consumed u_i; rad/s; latest-value physics inputs, not all published actions
execution_cost_secondary.thrust_impulse: integral sum abs T_i dt, N*s; not whole-body work

recovery: frozen sustained recovery/dwell criterion, interval start only after dwell confirmation; B interval shorter than dwell is insufficient observation, not recovered by one sample
models: M3/M4 frozen baselines and existing variants, no new candidate or fit; previous F4 miss now seen diagnostic only
prediction: whole/window classification, component tilt/height misses, OR separate, first sampled crossing brackets and full-prefix errors; scored with v2; no future inputs in blind pipeline
solver: eta from original full LCP matrix times solved lambda minus original b, independent post velocity; exact source row order/limits/clipping, all coupling, no eta from e_j; empirical magnitude not future bound
theory: conditional full A-hold/resume/recovery-to-B historical-deviation and height-margin map, irreversible historic failure; source-driven force/attitude/solver/cache domains and discrete integration defects explicit; no empirical maxima substituted for certified constants
counterexample_scope: equal tilt peaks with different thrust and residual vertical velocity can exhaust cumulative height; mechanical/envelope example is not a proven neural closed-loop reachable flight or A4 exclusion
stop_and_versions: v1 prep2 NOT_PASSED preserved; direct-v2 canonical read trace; v2 critical error stops affected queue; no formal revision mixed after freeze
